item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump vows to 'beat the f---ing s---' out of Iran following attack on U.S. forces in Jordan
item.description: U.S. Central Command (Centcom) revealed on Tuesday evening that Iran launched a series of ballistic missiles at a U.S. base in Jordan, in what the military agency referred to as a “surprise attack.”

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Telescope is set to explore dark matter and potential alien worlds
item.description: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Telescope mission is expected to revolutionize astrophysics, allowing scientists to unravel the mysteries of dark energy and dark matter.

item.description: Project 3 of the Moving I-4 Forward Program is focused on improving safety and connectivity west of U.S. 27 to west of ChampionsGate Boulevard.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Support for cellphone bans in schools reaches new high, survey finds

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] City of Tampa upgrades stormwater equipment to help prevent flooding
item.description: The City of Tampa is upgrading its stormwater equipment with a new Spyder machine designed to expedite ditch clearing and maintain its stormwater system.
